security_seniority_definition_003.evidence: Seniority means the greater number of years of consecutive employment as a teacher in the Minneapolis Public Schools unless herein otherwise specified.

security_involuntary_transfer_005.evidence: School reassignment decisions are made by the respective Special Education or Health Related Services administration (or their designee), in consultation with the staff involved.

security_rif_006.answer: Teachers may be exempted from district-wide layoff for designated programs (e.g., Racially Isolated Schools, Montessori, Immersion). Laid-off teachers receive first consideration for other qualified positions. Recall involves phone/certified notice, 7 days/next business day to accept. Recall rights terminate upon refusal, non-response, or 24 months post-discharge.
